Elena,

Thanks — received the packet. Short answers up front:

- Purchase reference format: we issue a Redwood PO number as PO-<6digits> and prefer vendors put that exact string in the "PO / Ref" field on invoices. If you need a customer-owned prefix, tell me why and we can assess.
- Spend caps: for trial/test phases we usually set a provisional spend band (default USD 50,000) that gates provisioned PO issuance. If you expect $42.3k in the first 60 days, that aligns with our standard onboarding band and should be ok. If you anticipate spiking beyond $50k we need an approval path.

Next steps from our side: Kimberly is our procurement lead and will open the onboarding ticket and request a provisional PO if everything checks out. Ben — FYI for sales planning and contract notes.

Action items:
- @kimberly_park: open ticket and confirm provisional PO process.
- @elena.park: if any of the vendor form fields differ from the attached, please highlight.

Cheers,
